What we do

Every service.
One crew — us.

You don't juggle five vendors with us. We bring the full production — sound, music, lights, mics, screens and the photo booth — and we run it all night.

01

Professional DJ

We read the room, mix live, and keep the energy exactly where you want it — from your first dance to the last song of the night.

02

Sound Systems & Reinforcement

We tune our professional sound systems to your venue — crisp, clear and powerful, so every speech, vow and beat lands perfectly.

03

Lighting & Lighting Effects

We light your room to set the mood and transform the space — elegant for dinner, electric when the dance floor opens.

04

Photo Booth Entertainment

Our photo booth is the one your guests line up for — the fun, take-home keepsake that keeps your party going between dances.

05

Wireless Microphone Systems

We run wireless mics for your ceremony, speeches, toasts, presentations and awards — no cables, no dropouts, no awkward feedback.

06

Audiovisual Support

We give you full AV support for presentations, slideshows, videos and live moments — set up, tested and run by us behind the scenes.

07

Customized & Curated Playlists

We build your playlist around your taste, your theme and your do-not-play list — so your soundtrack sounds like you, not a generic party mix.

08

Live Music Production & MC Hosting

We produce your live music and MC your night — announcements, transitions and timing, all handled by us so your event flows.

Types of events

We bring the
party to these

Weddings

From your ceremony to your reception, we create a seamless, enchanting audio experience that sets the perfect mood, amplifies the emotion, and reflects your unique style as a couple. We're a wedding DJ and live audio team based in Vancouver, BC, serving Burnaby, Metro Vancouver and the Lower Mainland — and we travel for destination weddings — ceremony sound, reception DJ, wireless mics for your speeches, lighting and our photo booth, all run by us.

Ceremony soundReception DJFirst danceSpeeches & toasts

Corporate Events

We bring professional audio that strengthens your communication, entertainment and brand presence — crisp sound reinforcement, wireless mics, AV support and playlists we customize for you, for a seamless, impactful event. From gala dinners in Vancouver to conferences in Burnaby, we scale our sound, lighting and photo booth to your room and your run sheet.

ConferencesSeminarsProduct launchesGala dinners

School Events

We partner with schools for their school events — proms, graduations and school dances, like NWSS prom night. We build a vibrant, energetic atmosphere your students actually love — playlists we curate carefully, professional sound and lighting effects that make memories that last a lifetime.

These are our own photos from NWSS Prom, Class of 2024 — no stock shots, no staging. That's our booth at the back of the room, our lights overhead, and a floor we kept packed from the first song to the last.

Areas we serve

Based in Vancouver, BC.
We serve local & international clients.

Vancouver, BC is home — it’s where we’re based, where our crew and our gear live, and where most of our nights happen. But our dance floors don’t stop at the city limits: we bring our DJ, sound, lighting and photo booth to celebrations across Metro Vancouver and the Lower Mainland, and we travel for clients across Canada and around the world.

Local — Metro Vancouver & the Lower Mainland

Our home region is where we work most — weddings, galas, school nights and celebrations of every kind across it. If your venue is anywhere in Metro Vancouver, the Fraser Valley or the wider Lower Mainland, we know the run — load-in, setup and sound check, handled.

Beyond — across Canada & around the world

Planning a destination wedding, a corporate event in another city, or a celebration outside Canada? While we’re based in Vancouver, BC, we do serve local and international clients — we travel with our production, or we build it with trusted partners on the ground where you are. Tell us where your night is happening, and we’ll tell you honestly how we’d run it.
